interpretation.positive_reference: The measurement occurred in a shot the coach assessed as Excellent. It is valid positive-reference evidence but does not establish a range or threshold by itself.
interpretation.good_default: A Good workflow default is not coach-labelled observation evidence unless the coach explicitly confirms or changes it.
interpretation.not_assessed: Not Assessed contributes no quality evidence.

not_assessed.label: Not Assessed
not_assessed.description: The phase or overall shot was intentionally not assessed; use Notes when an explanation is useful.

excellent.label: Excellent
excellent.description: An excellent execution of the phase or overall shot.

good.label: Good
good.description: A sound execution of the phase or overall shot with only minor opportunities for improvement.

needs_work.label: Needs Work
needs_work.description: The phase or overall shot contains one or more technical aspects requiring coaching attention.

red_flag.label: Red Flag
red_flag.description: A significant technical issue requiring immediate coaching attention.
